meta.title: Visual Font Manager
meta.description: Preview, compare and configure text, code and terminal fonts inside this plugin’s detail page without replacing built-in settings.

ui.title: Font Manager
ui.subtitle: Adjust text, code and terminal fonts, then apply your changes together.
ui.previewOnly: Preview does not change global fonts
ui.familyHint: Separate names with commas. Done updates the preview; leave empty for DSH defaults.
ui.familyPlaceholder: e.g. Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial
ui.libraryHint: Choose a card to preview it for the selected role.
ui.privacy: Reads font names from this browser’s device only after permission. The list stays on this page; no font files are uploaded or stored.
ui.localUnsupported: Local font enumeration is unavailable. You can still enter a font name; desktop Chrome or Edge is recommended.
ui.localDenied: Local font access was not granted. Try again or enter a family name manually.
ui.localEmpty: The browser returned no fonts. You can enter a family name manually.
ui.availableHint: Unverified fonts may fall back. Local availability does not guarantee coverage of every Chinese character.
ui.emptyHint: Try another search, or enter a font name in Advanced.
ui.sampleHint: Custom content stays in this scene and is never sent to a model or terminal.
ui.zoomHint: Enlarges the whole scene, including text, spacing and chrome. Applied font sizes are unchanged.
ui.sampleBody:
These changes preserve existing behavior while making the information hierarchy clearer. Prose explains the work, inline code identifies parameters and paths, and tables make results easier to compare.
Chinese 中文 and English can share a paragraph. Numbers 0123456789, punctuation and font weights should stay easy to distinguish.
ui.sampleTerminal:
andy@dsh:~/font-demo$ pnpm run check

> font-demo@1.0.0 check
> tsc --noEmit

✓ Type check passed
✓ 中文 paths and English output are readable

Files   12     Errors   0     Time   0.42s
andy@dsh:~/font-demo$
ui.sceneNote: Examples use DSH’s typographic proportions and interface styles without reading real sessions.
ui.fallbackHint: Fonts are matched in order, with system fallback for missing glyphs. Monospace fonts are recommended for code and terminals.
ui.restore: Restore inherited values for this role
ui.restoreHint: Removes user overrides for this role and restores inherited DSH values when applied.
ui.saved: Applied to DSH and synced with built-in font settings.
ui.scope: Applying affects all sessions and connected browsers in this DSH profile.
ui.failed: The write was not accepted. Your draft is preserved. Check access or reload current settings before retrying.
ui.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Your draft is preserved; discard and reload before editing to avoid overwriting another change.
ui.unavailable: The built-in font configuration is unavailable.
ui.readonly: This connection is read-only. Preview is available, but applying is disabled.
ui.roleHint: Configure each role separately. Selecting a font only changes this preview.
ui.noChange: Choose a font or change its size before applying.
ui.previewReadonly: Read-only example · no messages or commands are sent
ui.previewRoles: Text, code and terminal content each use their own font settings.
ui.previewScaleNote: 100% uses actual font sizes. Compare applied and preview settings in the same layout.
ui.sampleRoleHint: Replaces the current scene’s prose, code or terminal output. Both comparison panes use identical content.
ui.previewViewportNote: Both panes have equal width. Narrow windows stack them instead of shrinking text.
ui.pvUserText: Summarize these changes and give me a clear review checklist.
ui.pvUserCode: How should this font configuration be written? Check its types too.
ui.pvItemOne: Compare the readability of Chinese, English and numbers in longer paragraphs.
ui.pvItemTwo: Check list hierarchy, table density and ambiguous characters in code.
ui.pvQuote: Preview fonts only affect this area. DSH changes when you click Apply.
ui.pvInlineBefore: Before saving, check the fallback order in
ui.pvInlineAfter: . Missing glyphs will use the next available font.
ui.pvComposer: Ask a follow-up, or use @ to reference a file…
ui.pvCodeIntro: The three font roles affect body text, code and terminals independently. Here is an example:
ui.pvToolOutput:
> tsc --noEmit
Type check completed without errors.
[exit code: 0]
ui.pvCodeAfter: The check is complete. Inline code and code blocks use the code font; explanations keep the text font.
ui.pvTerminalNote: Uses native terminal fonts and sizes with a browser line-box approximation. Real xterm cell widths, row heights, wide glyphs and cursor rendering can differ.
ui.invalidSize: Enter an integer from {min} to {max}; press Esc to restore the preview size.
ui.invalidFamily: The normalized font family list must not exceed 2048 characters.
ui.restorePartialTag: Restore inherited values, with individually edited fields
ui.localNotRead: Local fonts have not been read
ui.localReadHint: Choose Read local fonts and grant permission to see the full local list.
ui.pickerHint: Suggestions are not necessarily installed. Select to preview; missing fonts fall back.
ui.terminalShortNote: Approximate terminal preview; real cell dimensions may differ.
ui.discardConfirm: Discard all role drafts and unfinished size inputs, then reload applied settings. This does not change DSH configuration.
